song.title: I Just Want To Make Love To You

guitar.evidence: Foghat's Rod Price was known for slide work often on a Gibson Les Paul; reasonably documented in classic rock guitar circles.
guitar.notes: Filled from unknown with medium confidence.

tone.target: raw blues-rock crunch with gritty lead bite
tone.profile: raw blues-rock crunch with gritty lead bite
tone.summary: A vintage-inspired chain using a Blues OD for grit, followed by the UK 45 amp model into a UK Vintage 4x12 cab, providing the necessary raw blues-rock crunch and tube break-up.

rig.name: Foghat - I Just Want To Make Love To You - Valeton GP-180
